correctness.rationale: Independent sixth multinomial expansion for independent symmetric sparse signs gives E(sum a_j X_j)^6=15+15(t-3)s_2+(t^2-15t+30)s_3 on x_j=a_j²,sum x=1. For phi(z)=Az²+Bz³, phi(u)+phi(v)=phi(u+v)+uv[-2A-3B(u+v)] is affine in pair product, forcing equalization or deletion. At 3<t<5 unequal positive weights cannot persist with a third coordinate under pair perturbations, so maximizers have equal nonzero x; at t=5 D(s)=60(s-1) permits arbitrary one/two-coordinate splits, at t>5 forces singletons, at 1<=t<=3 forces full flat support. F_k(t) adjacent sign follows strictly decreasing R(t)=-B/A crossing increasing k(k+1)/(2k+1), so every tau_k strictly ordered and k(tau_k-3)->4/5. The continuous envelope yields C_infty^6=15+(75/8)(t-3)^2+O((t-3)^3). Independently evaluated exact multinomial examples and nine adjacent roots.
